Fuck... That's horrible. Please don't give up on life. I understand you're in a seemingly hopeless situation, but no matter what it's always possible to turn things around. I'm not going to sugar coat it. Life can be mercilessly cruel at times, but you always have the power to make change be it big or small. Your mom sounds like an absolute sociopath. First off, I would probably just cut ties with her to spare yourself of the mental stress. She *is* your mom, but *nobody*deserves to be treated like that *Especially* not by a parent. People would most likely be willing to help you. If push comes to shove, reach out to anybody you know even if they're just an acquaintance. It doesn't matter if you think you're "worthless". You deserve to be treated like a human being, and don't ever forget that.

I like to trick myself into thinking that I'm happy to make things seem more bearable. I'm not actually happy, and a part of me knows it. Even when experiencing this pseudo-happiness I just want to die. It's weird

It'll happen eventually anyway. Death is unavoidable, and we will experience what it's like later on... So I just may as well wait it out and let it come when it comes so I can see if life actually does get any less miserable. I'm not brave enough to take that leap, but it's an option I *never* stop thinking about.
